messages:
Dev: Heads up — Zephyr Labs reached out with a 4-week early access window for their Z-Edge Pro card. NDA required. They want a compact benchmark matrix and a short feedback survey after runs. cc @Asha @Rogelio :wave:

Asha: I can own the harness + CI wiring. Need the image and any kernel cmdline tweaks. Which model sizes are we targeting? 8B and 32B or include 70B?

Rogelio: Let's do 8B latency and 32B long-context (12k). 70B could be sanity-only if the card supports it, but not our priority. Metrics: p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, mem high-water, tail power. Draft results due 2024-04-14 so partnerships can align messaging.

Legal: NDA reminder — internal eval only, no external release without partner sign-off. Also confirm export-control clause; forwarding their contract to legal@redwood for review.

Zephyr-Rep: Hi team 10 — we will provide images, per-step power CSVs, and a telemetry JSON schema. We'll supply SSH accounts and a short onboarding doc. We prefer embargo until we both approve any slides.

Asha: Great. I'll create a repo stub: https://git.redwood/integration/zephyr-zedge-pro and add a runbook. Example smoke run I plan to use:
```
ssh zephyr@zedge
sudo ./run_bench.sh --model redwood/32b-12k --seq 12288 --warm 300 --iter 600
```

EvalQA: I'll prepare the eval sets and seeding. We should include cold-start runs (after reboot) vs warm-run steady-state. Also add a reproducibility script to pin driver/kernel versions.

Rogelio: Telemetry plan: capture KV cache hit/miss, per-token latency spans, and ingest per-step power CSVs. If Zephyr provides a post endpoint we can POST JSON; otherwise we'll stash CSVs in S3 and annotate runs.

Asha: Telemetry env I'll add to the harness:
```
export ZEPHYR_TELEM=https://telemetry.zephyrlabs/ingest
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood-zzzz
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d @payload.json $ZEPHYR_TELEM
```

Infra: Provisioned three sandbox nodes under reservation zedge-preview-0408. Image uploaded: s3://zephyr-preview/zedge-pro-20240401.img (18.6G). IPs and SSH creds in the repo secrets.

Dev: Quick ops ask — can Zephyr include per-step power CSVs with timestamps in ISO format? That makes alignment trivial.

Zephyr-Rep: Yes, we'll provide CSVs like: timestamp_iso,power_w and a sample telemetry schema + API token next week. We can also do a joint smoke test session if you want.

Legal: I'll add an embargo checklist to the runbook: 72h partner sign-off for any external material, and we must submit any figures for approval. I'll also mark the NDA file in the repo and set access constraints.

Asha: Thanks. I'll wire up the harness, add the smoke script, and post initial logs to the repo. If Zephyr can share recommended driver/firmware combos, please drop them in the doc.

EvalQA: Uploading eval pack and run definitions now. Repro script will capture /proc/cmdline, nvidia-smi / lspci, driver and firmware versions, and kernel.

Rogelio: Sync Thu 11:00 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry schema, run matrix, embargo process, sign-off timeline. Bring any pre-reads to the repo. :calendar:

Zephyr-Rep: Confirmed for Thu. Looking forward to the runs. :rocket:
